summary.en: Hundreds rallied in Ukhrul, Manipur demanding an end to ethnic violence and the SoO pact. Manipur chief minister Khemchand Singh met families of two Kuki youths killed in Kangpokli and said the case was handed to NIA while the home minister Govindas Konthoujam said displaced persons would be returned safely. Prime Minister Modi declared the Bastar district Naxal free and warned that "dimagi" Naxals have infiltrated political parties, while over 4,000 firearms were recovered in Manipur raising new security concerns. The Manipur census remains suspended until April 2027 per the high court, and 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Hundrevis samlet seg i Ukhrul, Manipur, og krevde en slutt på etnisk vold og SoO-pakten. Manipur sin statsminister Khemchand Singh møtte familiene til to Kuki-ungdommer som ble drept i Kangpokli og sa at saken ble overført til NIA, mens innenriksminister Govindas Konthoujam sa at fortrengte personer ville bli returnert trygt. Statsminister Modi erklærte Bastar-distriktet som Naxal-fritt og advarte om at «dimagi» Naxaler har infiltrert politiske partier, mens over 4 000 skytevåpen ble funnet i Manipur og skapte nye sikkerhetsbekymringer. Manipur-folketellingen forblir suspendert til april 2027 etter høyesterettskjennelse, og 437 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
